items.title: 索尼自断粮道?小岛新作看来要上PC了:PS6护航OUT
items.summary: 索尼自断粮道?小岛谍报新作看来要上PC了:PS5 OUT

content.v: 由你来说： 原本被视为小岛秀夫与PlayStation再次合作的谍战大作《Physint》，突然被索尼放弃，转头又被Xbox接手，接下来它究竟还会不会登陆PS5甚至PS6？
9月10日，索尼PlayStation宣布，经过考虑后决定退出与小岛制作的《Physint》合作。不过小岛秀夫随后透露，早在2026年6月中旬，SIE就已经通知小岛制作组“取消目前正在制作中的《Physint》项目”。为了让这款作品继续开发，小岛团队花了约三个月寻找新合作伙伴，最终选择与Xbox携手。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609101110362100.png
Xbox官方随后确认，Xbox将与小岛制作合作发行《Physint》，并表示双方合作还将延伸至电影和电视剧领域。小岛秀夫则表示，《Physint》依旧是一款面向下一世代的谍战动作游戏，目前开发并未停止。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609101111101517.jpg
消息公布后，玩家的反应迅速分成两派。一部分Xbox玩家把这看成一次“捡漏”，认为Xbox成功接手小岛的新IP；也有玩家感慨，原本与PlayStation关系密切的小岛，如今却因为索尼退出而转向微软。Reddit相关讨论中，不少玩家直接质疑索尼为何会放弃这个项目，甚至有人认为这是PlayStation又一次“自断后路”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609101111494420.png
与此同时，《Physint》未来的平台问题成为最大悬念。由于Xbox目前已经成为项目新的合作伙伴，一些玩家开始猜测游戏大概率会登陆Xbox、PC，甚至加入Game Pass。不过截至目前，官方只确认Xbox参与发行，并没有宣布独占策略，也没有正式说明PS5或未来PlayStation主机版本是否取消，因此这些仍属于玩家推测。

https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609101113339704.png
大家觉得《Physint》未来还会登陆PS5/PS6吗？还是小岛这次真的要全面转向Xbox和PC了？

items.title: 苹果折叠屏为何命名“Duo”奥迪表示什么意思我最清楚
items.summary: 日前苹果首款折叠屏手机命名“iPhone Duo”引发热议。据悉，Duo在拉丁语和德语中意为“二”，精准概括了折叠屏“合二为一”的产品形态。不过，在汽车圈，这个词早在36年前就被奥迪写进了技术史。 1989年法兰克福车展

content.v: 日前苹果首款折叠屏手机命名“iPhone Duo”引发热议。
据悉，Duo在拉丁语和德语中意为“二”，精准概括了折叠屏“合二为一”的产品形态。不过，在汽车圈，这个词早在36年前就被奥迪写进了技术史。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260910/1789009864_891437.png
1989年法兰克福车展上，奥迪基于100 Avant打造了第一代Audi duo混合动力概念车。
前轮由一台2.3升五缸汽油发动机驱动，输出约134马力，后轮则由一台9千瓦（约12马力）的电动机推动，采用镍镉电池储能。
奥迪在当时就提出了“郊区用油、城区用电”的双驱动理念，驾驶者可自由切换驱动方式。这在混动技术尚未普及的年代，堪称超前。
1996年，奥迪推出第三代Duo，基于A4 Avant打造，换装1.9升TDI柴油发动机与20千瓦电动机，采用铅酸凝胶电池，纯电模式下可行驶至80公里/小时。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260910/1789009856_625937.png
这是奥迪第三款混动车型，也是首款面向市场销售的混动产品，当时售价约6万德国马克。
苹果方面，“Duo”这个词同样有历史渊源。1992年，苹果推出PowerBook Duo系列笔记本，定位超轻薄便携，产品代号“BOB W”（Best Of Both Worlds，两全其美），意在兼顾便携与桌面性能，该系列一直销售至1997年。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: 《宝可梦pokopia》第二款扩展内容公布新预告，确认将有七只新增宝可梦登场。此次扩展不会加入新区域，内容重点将放在本体已有宝可梦的新服装和配饰上。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260910/1789009753_100220.webp
这段预告在周三举行的任天堂直面会上首次亮相，展示了向尾喵、嘟嘟和长尾火狐。由于游戏收录宝可梦时也会加入其余进化形态，嘟嘟利、优雅猫、火狐狸和妖火红狐也将进入本次扩展。
与第二款扩展不同，首款扩展“泡泡盆地”加入了一个新区域，并增加约50只宝可梦。新扩展目前公开的方向主要是扩充服装及配饰内容，官方尚未公布新的探索区域。
《宝可梦pokopia》由光荣特库摩旗下Omega Force团队主导开发，核心制作人员包括《勇者斗恶龙：创世小玩家2》的导演。本作是Nintendo Switch 2独占游戏，于今年3月发售。
任天堂与宝可梦公司上月确认，本作发售以来销量已经超过500万份。实体版采用游戏钥匙卡形式，卡内主要提供游戏下载所需的数据，而非收录完整游戏内容。
第二款扩展的具体上线时间尚未在现有信息中公布，目前已经确认的主要变化为七只新增宝可梦以及面向本体宝可梦推出的新服装和配饰。

items.title: 屏下摄像头技术差了五代 努比亚喊话苹果

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609101102423336.png
9月10日 IT之家报道 ，苹果发布首款折叠屏手机iPhone Duo，该机采用了屏下摄像头技术，引发讨论。对此，中兴通讯终端事业部总裁、努比亚技术有限公司总裁倪飞公开做出回应。倪飞表示：“等了几年，终于看到苹果也开始做屏下，挺感慨的。这个方向，努比亚从2020年的Axon 20就开始了，一路做到第七代。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609101105308816.jpg
他提到，屏下技术好不好，关键看显示彩色画面时摄像头所在的那块屏幕会不会“露馅”。早期的屏下方案看彩色视频像隔了一层纱；到了第七代，彩色画面下那块区域与整块屏幕的像素密度完全一致，肉眼看不到摄像头。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609101103013340.jpg
倪飞表示，从目前情况看，苹果大概率还在第二代屏下技术，而努比亚已经做到第七代，并欢迎苹果加入屏下这条赛道。他还提到，想体验万元以内且更成熟的屏下技术，可以关注努比亚Z80U与红魔11系列。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609101103017505.jpg
另据苹果官网介绍，iPhone Duo配备4800万像素融合式双摄系统，包含4800万像素融合式超广角与4800万像素融合式主摄，前置为1200万像素Center Stage摄像头，另有一颗支持1080p视频的屏下FaceTime摄像头，可实现双屏通话。

items.title: 游民采访柳叶刀：没有《边境》就拿不到《流浪地球》
items.summary: 柳叶刀工作室坦言，前作《边境》虽市场表现不佳，却因此争取来了《流浪地球》项目

content.v: 在不久前的游先看活动中，我们采访到了《流浪地球：望日》的制作团队，了解到了许多与游戏有关的信息。
本作是一款基于刘慈欣原著小说《流浪地球》直接授权（非电影）的线性叙事第三人称射击单机游戏，由柳叶刀工作室承制研发，瀚海星穹则为IP方和发行方，刘慈欣本人担任游戏监制。游戏为纯单机，暂无多人模式。
故事发生在“刹车时代”第46年，即人类将月球推离地球轨道的最后窗口期，主角是一名月球工程工程师，因卷入一场袭击而牵出地球派与飞船派长达300年的路线之争。游戏舞台设定在月球，是对原著小说中“推离月球”这一简略事件的原创扩展改编。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/09/20260910_wzx_512_1/1296.jpg
在采访中，柳叶刀团队强调游戏将以硬科幻写实为风格，拒绝魔幻或幻想向的设计。游戏将以射击体验为核心进行打磨，加入“三准星解锁”系统、外肢体机械臂（可辅助持握重型武器或与环境交互）、多种未来单兵装备及太空载具，并利用不同重力环境与“月球发动机”等巨型太空设施营造沉浸感。
开发进度方面，双方于2024年接触，经过近一年提案磨合，2026年3月正式启动开发，目前尚处早期开发阶段。
柳叶刀工作室坦言，前作《边境》虽市场表现不佳，却因此争取来了《流浪地球》项目，并为本作积累了宝贵的技术与制作经验。而原著作者刘慈欣对改编持高度开放态度，给予制作团队充分的信任和创作自由。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/09/20260910_wzx_512_1/1580.jpg
以下是采访中具体的问题与回答：
Q：看资料显示2024年与瀚海合作，但游戏是今年春节后才正式开发，中间有一年空窗期？请问项目现在进度如何，大概什么时候能玩？
A：前期双方花了大量时间进行合作洽谈、打磨提案和建立信任，并不是停滞。2024年底基本达成意向，2026年3月正式启动联合开发。目前确实还处在早期阶段，但肯定不是“PPT游戏”。
Q：柳叶刀工作室的前作《边境》也是太空射击题材，并且成绩不是很理想，请问新项目与它有没有承接关系？是不是有种太空题材没有做过瘾在这个项目上继续做的想法？
A：两部作品没有直接的关系，在内部这两个项目分得还是比较开的，设定和资产是肯定不通用的。应该说《边境》为我们积累了太空硬科幻的技术储备和创作经验，可能会有一些视觉设计看起来比较相像。然而之所以会有流浪地球这个项目，是因为我们做了《边境》，如果没有它的话我们一定是拿不到这个项目的。
其实太空射击这个题材是我们团队共同的兴趣，每次也是憋着劲做的。而我们柳叶刀一个座右铭就是满足玩家对于射击的幻想，无论是太空军事题材、现代战争、警匪片，只要能够满足射击这个幻想的所有题材，我们都想做。
并且需要强调的是，这里说的幻想不是奇幻，我们只做硬核写实方向，不做奇幻射击。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/09/20260910_wzx_512_1/11108.jpg
Q：原著中推离月球后就没再提月球了，游戏完全以月球为舞台，这是对世界观的原创拓展吗？定位是怎样的？
A：是的，它确实是对原著世界观的一次“切片式”扩展，我记得原著这段剧情仅有两万三千字，很多事件一笔带过。我们选取“推离月球”这个细节，围绕它展开完整原创故事，同时保证所有设定与原著保持一致，而具体的派别、组织、具体事件都是原创，就是把小说的一个很小的，其中语言描述不多的一个事件进行扩展，成为我们游戏的一个主要的故事。
Q：团队在美术视觉上希望达成什么方向？是否会形成类似《黑客帝国》《银翼杀手》那样一眼可辨的独特风格？
A：我们肯定是想做一个独特的视觉风格，能够在匹配这个 IP的同时形成我们自己独特的世界观，当前我们追求的是硬核科幻写实的方向，其中有个重要的指标是遵循更加科学理性的一个角度和分析方式，去呈现和组织我们的一些美术概念设计。也就是说我们不会做一个很 fantasy 的这样的一个概念，而是能够落地的、写实的、匹配《流浪地球》这样一个硬科幻的 IP 的气质的一整套美术。
从设计的角度来讲，现在游戏行业里边说硬核，其实大家的理解有些不太一样，如果让我来提炼的话，可能是更多的是这种人类工业设计的这种冷峻感和落地感，让大家看到这是人类科技水平能够设计出来的东西，而不是随随便便抛出一个设定。这样的硬核是我们从之前的游戏中继承下来的，也希望能延续到这个游戏，以及未来的游戏中去。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/09/20260910_wzx_512_1/11706.jpg
Q：有考虑多人模式吗？另外，PV里看到机械臂等装备，是否会针对不同环境设计特殊玩法？比如在某些关卡弱化射击元素，强化场景交互？
A：《流浪地球：望日》没有多人模式，本作为纯单机体验。
关于玩法，射击倒也不是说弱化，因为射击肯定是我们最核心最基础的一个体验和游玩的方式。但线性叙事游戏不能“从头突到尾”，因此我们会加入非战斗的任务和交互，而机械臂其实是人体功能的延伸，比如如抓握、持重武器、辅助移动等，它的设计跟射击玩法是相互耦合的。
我们想表达的射击体验，是当玩家拿起鼠标按下的左键，拿起手柄扣动扳机键的一刹那整体的射击体验和反馈，这是我们的基本盘，射击做不好就意味着没有做及格。而所有的设计都是基于我们能否给玩家带来有趣和惊喜的体验，机械臂只是其中的一种形式。流浪地球现在发生的事情是从现在到三四百年之后的事情，给我们提供了很大的这种想象的空间，我们希望将这些有趣、惊喜或者有些调皮的体验带给大家。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/09/20260910_wzx_512_1/12109.jpg
Q：刚才演示的三准星瞄准系统具体怎么给玩家惊喜？并且在演示中我只看到两个准星，第三个在哪？
A：“三准星”是中文谐音梗，实际是两个浮动准星 + 屏幕中心（摄像机中心）。传统射击游戏准星永远锁定屏幕正中心，而我们希望让枪口指向与玩家视线解锁，带来更加沉浸的叙事体验，做一些新的尝试。大家不需要将多个准星当做某种专有名词去理解，我们是一个体验型的射击游戏，这套系统还是等大家玩到以后再进一步解释吧
Q：请问与刘慈欣合作过程中，有没有印象深刻的话或互动？
A：大刘对改编作品非常包容，原话是“只要改编出来是一个好的作品，他就很满意”。大刘尊重每个合作团队在自己领域内的专业性，虽然对自己IP的授权选择极为苛刻，但一旦选定合作方，就会充分信任，给予创作空间，不会过度干预。这种信任让我们能放开手脚发挥专业能力。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/09/20260910_wzx_512_1/12463.jpg
Q：PV里提到地球派与飞船派300年路线之争，是否还有更多派系或更深层的剧情？
A：目前剧情细节不便透露。但可以确定的是，我们会依据原著信息，呈现一个生动、精彩且有深度的故事，具体派系构成和冲突展开还请期待后续公布。

items.title: The next game by the creators of Steins;Gate is an entirely vibe-coded FPS slopfest
items.summary: At least it's free, mostly.

content.v: Juggernaut is a forthcoming free-to-play boomer shooter clearly styled after Wolfenstein engine FPSes of yore. It's about shooting huge waves of zombies in flat, pixellated arenas. As far as modern retro shooters go it looks unremarkable, though it will be released alongside the Juggernaut Assets Maker, a paid tool for making your own levels and adding your own assets. "Make it more Japanese" the Steam page promises. "Make it sexier".

It's the work of Mages Inc, a Japanese studio best known for the Steins;Gate series of visual novels; it has also worked on recent iterations of the Corpse Party series. Mages Inc generally specialises in visual novels, though it has released at least one Xbox 360 action game that was never released outside of Japan.
But to what extent Mages Inc can actually be credited (or blamed) for their first foray into the first-person shooter genre is ripe for debate, because here's Juggernaut's AI Disclosure:
AI Breakdown Source code: 100% Graphics: 60% Sound: 50% Effects: 100%

In other words, this FPS is entirely vibe-coded, and its assets are overwhelmingly the work of generative AI. The Juggernaut Asset Maker , which will cost money, carries a similar disclosure: "The source code for this application was generated using generative AI".

Mages Inc isn't the best known studio in the world, but it's been around for over 20 years and has issued a handful of games that most enthusiasts would have heard of. Steins;Gate has nearly 6,000 "overwhelmingly positive" reviews on Steam; the recent Steins;Gate Re:Boot, which was released on August 20, already has nearly 600 "very positive" reviews.

So it's surprising how heavily they're leaning into generative AI with Juggernaut. Some Steam users have taken to the Juggernaut discussions board to air their grievances: "If you don't care enough to make a game why should I care enough to buy it?" one user asks.

Games with AI disclosures count for nearly half of all games released on Steam every week, though few are as upfront as Mages Inc has been with its loose stats-driven approach. Games that are (or appear to be) predominantly the result of generative AI are generally all but invisible to Steam's discovery algorithms, especially the recent wave of similar-looking incremental games . Is this the first completely vibe-coded game from a renowned studio?

content.v: 就在刚刚 我们报道 ，索尼突然宣布正式退出与小岛秀夫合作的谍战新作《PHYSINT》，并表示这是经深思熟虑后做出的一个艰难决定。同一时间，小岛工作室官方发文，表示将和Xbox合作。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609101054156544.jpg
随后，小岛秀夫也在个人社交媒体上公布了此次合作的更多幕后细节。据介绍，今年六月中旬，SIE突然向小岛工作室发来通知，要求“取消目前正在制作中的《PHYSINT》项目”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609101224269330.jpg
但是小岛秀夫表示：“无论对我个人还是对小岛工作室来说，《PHYSINT》都是一个非常重要的项目。为了无论如何都能让项目继续下去，我们在过去3个月里一直在寻找‘新的合作伙伴’。”
“在听取了各方人士的意见并持续推进谈判的过程中，我们最终决定再次与Xbox携手合作，因为我们认为对方是能够与我们共同分享“未来愿景”的合作伙伴。作为一款面向下一世代的‘谍报动作游戏’，《PHYSINT》目前仍在继续制作中，所以请大家不要担心。”

items.summary: 动视公布了《使命召唤：现代战争4》的一项预购奖励。所有平台的预购玩家均可获得“Inner Circuit”M4武器蓝图，其中Xbox玩家看到的将是纪念Xbox诞生25周年的透明绿色版本。这款专属外观采用初代Xbox标志性

content.v: 动视公布了《使命召唤：现代 战争 4》的一项预购奖励。所有平台的预购玩家均可获得“Inner Circuit”M4武器蓝图，其中Xbox玩家看到的将是纪念Xbox诞生25周年的透明绿色版本。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260910/1789008024_521633.png
这款专属外观采用初代Xbox标志性的透明绿色设计，玩家能够透过枪身看到内部结构。其他平台的预购玩家同样可以获得这把武器，但蓝图不会带有Xbox主题装饰。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260910/1789008031_218439.png
平台之间的显示也存在差异。使用PlayStation或Switch 2游玩时，玩家不会看到透明绿色的Xbox外观，只有Xbox平台会显示这一设计。
两种蓝图仅在视觉效果上有所区别，所配备的配件和实际游戏性能完全相同。因此，Xbox专属内容不会改变武器数值或玩法表现。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260910/1789008040_181714_png_r.webp
除专属武器外观外，微软还将向购买Xbox版《使命召唤：现代战争4》的玩家提供5美元额度。微软此前收购了动视及《使命召唤》系列，并曾向监管机构承诺，不会削弱该系列在Xbox以外平台上的内容，确保各平台版本保持一致。
时任Xbox负责人菲尔·斯宾塞在2023年表示，微软无意利用《使命召唤》推动玩家购买Xbox主机。《使命召唤：现代战争4》将于10月23日发售，登陆PS5、Xbox Series X|S、Switch 2及PC平台。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: 【更新】根据小岛秀夫本人的说法，PlayStation 工作室在今年六月突然单方面通知他将取消《PHYSINT》项目。此后三个月，他与团队积极寻找新合作伙伴，最终与 XBOX 达成合作。
【原文】索尼互动娱乐宣布，在深思熟虑后，不再与小岛工作室合作打造IP谍报动作游戏《PHYSINT》。
索尼表示：“我们对小岛秀夫对这款游戏的愿景依然深怀敬意。在长达三十年的行业领先、开创流派的创意合作之后，双方的关系依然深厚，我们期待未来继续与小岛秀夫及其屡获殊荣的独立工作室保持紧密合作。”
https://image.gcores.com/c85cfc644eeb86927338f28dfe74a93a-1536-864.jpg
与此同时，微软宣布接手《PHYSINT》的开发。XBOX 首席执行官 Asha Sharma 表示："创作者有权选择在哪里、以何种方式将创意付诸实现。我们深感荣幸，小岛桑选择 XBOX 与他的小岛工作室一同开发 PHYSINT。他挑战惯例的雄心壮志，正是我们在 XBOX 所希望支持的那种创造力。"
小岛秀夫表示："这次合作将我们与 XBOX 的关系延伸至《OD》之外。在推进 PHYSINT 开发的过程中，我们依然致力于为全球玩家重新定义动作谍战类型游戏。"除《OD》与 PHYSINT 外，微软和小岛工作室的合作还将延伸至游戏以外的领域。据悉，双方将在电影及影视剧方面展开协作，向更广泛的受众呈现全新故事。

此次试玩地点位于美国加利福尼亚州卡尔弗城。有玩家注意到，在主要的格斗游戏开发商中，只有卡普空和Riot Games在当地设有办公地点，而Riot旗下的《2XKO》此前刚刚宣布暂停开发，因此有观点据此猜测，这次测试的神秘项目或许与卡普空有关。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609101035199383.jpg
不过，目前尚无证据能够证明该项目就是卡普空的新作。Good Gamer Group自身的总部同样位于卡尔弗城，因此也不排除这是其他游戏公司委托Good Gamer Group进行的线下测试。换言之，仅凭试玩地点目前还无法确定游戏的开发商，卡普空究竟是否还有未公布的新作，仍有待进一步消息确认。

items.title: Steam出台新规 澳大利亚玩家购买18+游戏需信用卡验证年龄
items.summary: 本周，Steam加入Xbox和PlayStation行列，要求澳大利亚用户在购买成人限定游戏前进行年龄验证。但与另外两家平台不同，Valve目前仅允许一种验证方式：将信用卡绑定至Steam账户。 未绑定信用卡的用户尝试访

content.v: 本周，Steam加入Xbox和PlayStation行列，要求澳大利亚用户在购买成人限定游戏前进行年龄验证。但与另外两家平台不同，Valve目前仅允许一种验证方式：将信用卡绑定至Steam账户。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260910/1789007244_209491.jpg
未绑定信用卡的用户尝试访问部分商店页面时，会看到提示：“Valve须根据《年龄限制材料应用分发服务准则》验证您已年满18岁方可访问成人内容。如需继续，请添加一张有效的澳大利亚信用卡，随后更新成人内容偏好设置。”
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260910/1789007252_473555_jpg_r.jpg
Valve的逻辑不难理解：申请信用卡须年满18岁，且银行开卡时已核验过多种政府身份证件。问题在于，并非所有人都持有信用卡。澳大利亚总人口约2800万，其中成年人约2200万，而信用卡注册量仅为1470万张——这意味着数百万成年澳大利亚人没有信用卡。这些用户显然不会为了在Steam上玩R18+游戏而专门去申请一张信用卡。
更令人困惑的是，虽然Valve的提示明确要求信用卡，但有澳大利亚用户报告称，部分借记卡——尤其是该国四大银行的借记卡——可以成功验证，另一些则不行。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260910/1789007259_270920_jpg_r.jpg
与Xbox和PlayStation提供多种验证方式(包括上传政府身份证件)不同，Valve仅提供信用卡一条路径。此外，年龄验证本身的有效性也存疑：部分平台允许面部识别扫描，结果被用户用《如龙》主角桐生一马的图像轻松绕过。隐私与数据安全方面的担忧同样存在。
这并非Steam首次在澳大利亚问题上“敷衍了事”。澳大利亚竞争与消费者委员会曾将Valve告上法庭，联邦法院最终确认Valve在消费者权益方面存在误导行为。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 15999元起！iPhone Duo仅支持eSIM 中国移动回应
items.summary: 快科技9月10日消息，今日凌晨，苹果首款折叠屏手机iPhone Duo正式亮相秋季发布会。这款新机国行起步价为15999元，256GB 版本定价159…

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609101024514827.png
快科技9月10日消息，今日凌晨，苹果首款折叠屏手机iPhone Duo正式亮相秋季发布会。这款新机国行起步价为15999元，256GB 版本定价15999元，顶配2TB版本售价达到26499元。该机将于10月23日正式开售。
这款机型最大的变化是取消了实体SIM卡槽，全球所有版本都只能依靠eSIM联网，不再支持插卡使用。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609101024573413.webp
按照苹果给出的说明，国内用户必须携带本人身份证件，前往线下运营商网点完成实名核验，才能完成号码开通与设备激活，无法在线上自助办理。
针对这款纯eSIM机型，中国移动客服作出回应。工作人员表示，移动目前已经开通eSIM业务，不过这项服务适配机型会持续更新，存在机型适配差异。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609101025028554.jpg
官方建议消费者不要提前办理，等到新机到手之后，携带手机与身份证前往指定营业厅现场办理，确保号码可以正常写入设备。

items.title: 苹果折叠屏官方1万6起 黄牛加价顶配飙到4万！
items.summary: iPhone Duo国行15999元起，黄牛已开预售，普遍加价5000元以上。

content.v: 苹果秋季发布会推出iPhone 18 Pro系列，以及品牌首款折叠屏机型iPhone Duo。这也是苹果首次进入折叠屏手机市场。iPhone Duo国行起售价15999元，共提供四个存储版本：256GB售价15999元、512GB售价17999元、1TB售价21499元、2TB售价26499元。该机将于10月16日晚8点接受预订，10月23日正式发售。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609101019299302.jpg
新机尚未开售，黄牛市场已提前开张。据多家媒体报道，目前普遍加价在5000元以上，顶配版本报价甚至接近4万元。一位数码店老板表示，现在都是预售，加价2000到5000元，先交1000元定金；另一位卖家则称，现在卖的都是“期货”，“苹果最火，折叠就是硬通货”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609101019365798.jpg
有分析师预测，一旦开启预购，iPhone Duo极可能出现“秒售罄”，发货周期或迅速拉长至4到6周甚至更久，黄牛渠道的溢价幅度预计在50%到100%之间。

items.title: 《东方红魔乡：新典》正式发售 Steam好评如潮！
items.summary: 9月9日，游戏《东方红魔乡：新典～ the Embodiment of Scarlet Devil》正式发售。本作是对2002年由上海爱丽丝幻乐团开发、并由系列不朽作者ZUN亲自参与制作的邪典纵版射击游戏的全新重构。正如

content.v: 9月9日，游戏《东方红魔乡：新典～ the Embodiment of Scarlet Devil》正式发售。本作是对2002年由上海爱丽丝幻乐团开发、并由系列不朽作者ZUN亲自参与制作的邪典纵版射击游戏的全新重构。正如ZUN本人所言，这次更新是由已经成长且更有经验的开发者打造的，这体现在了这部经典作品的方方面面。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260910/1789006861_231236_jpg_r.jpg
Steam商店页面： 东方红魔乡：新典～ the Embodiment of Scarlet Devil

在经典项目的新版本中，视觉部分经过了彻底重制。作者将像素画面更新至适应现代高分辨率屏幕，保留了系列标志性的风格，同时让画面摆脱了原作旧时代的局限。玩家将再次沉浸于 弹幕 地狱之中，屏幕上布满由数百发弹幕构成的极其复杂的图案，要求玩家具备精湛的反应能力和精准的角色走位。音乐伴奏也经历了大规模改动。原版游戏的所有曲目均由ZUN本人重新编曲，在获得现代音效的同时不失其标志性氛围。此外，扩展版Deluxe Edition还收录了超过30首曲目，既包括全新旋律，也包含2002年版本中令人怀念的经典曲调。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260910/1789006861_918127_jpg_r.jpg
玩家可选择两位熟悉的角色，巫女灵梦和魔法使魔理沙，各自拥有独特的战斗风格。此外，本作还对新手十分友好，开发者设置了无限生命的特殊模式，大幅降低了这一硬核射击游戏类型的入门门槛。不过，限制尝试次数的经典通关方式也依然保留，供喜爱严酷挑战的玩家选择。同时，购买基础版的玩家还将额外获得2002年原版日文版，以便了解其源头。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260910/1789006861_657706_jpg_r.jpg
目前本作在Steam上拥有1,690条评论，其中98%为好评，获“好评如潮”评价，玩家称赞本次全面重制立绘原汁原味，音乐更是好听，操作手感流畅，UI更是华丽又简洁。唯一被吐槽的一点就是新版与旧版的捆绑销售，无法将《东方红魔乡：新典》从合集中单独购买，因此玩家不得不直接购买包含经典版或原声带的套装。
《东方红魔乡：新典》正式发售，Steam捆绑包售价69元，带原声带的豪华版售价97.75元。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: Attendees will be able to check out a demo of The Witcher 3 DLC Songs of the Past behind closed doors at PAX Australia
items.summary: It's not that far away, come on.

content.v: I'm looking forward to an expansion for a game from 2015 more than I am for pretty much any new game coming up. The Songs of the Past add-on for The Witcher 3, which will be out next year, promises to let us explore a whole new region and get to know Dandelion better than ever. I'm more interested in a brand new chunk of world than intimate moments with the bard, but more Witcher 3 is more Witcher 3 even if the focus isn't on everyone's actual favorite character. (Johnny the Godling, of course.)

Songs of the Past was shown off at Gamescom, where our Joshua Wolens had a peek and said it looked real good . The rest of us will have to wait for other opportunities, like the one that's been announced as part of the PAX Australia schedule reveal. On Saturday, October 11, attendees will be able to join members of CD Projekt and DLC developer Fool's Theory for a behind-closed-doors live demo of Songs of the Past, and a panel discussion to follow.

Other events planned for the three-day event include Storytime with World of Warcraft executive producer Holly Longdale, Final Fantasy 14 veterans Koji Fox and Toshio 'Foxclon' Murouchi suffering through a hot-sauce interview in "A Realm Reburned", and Saros' creative director Gregory Louden talking about a career that's included work on games like Control and Returnal.

The tabletop side of gaming will also be well covered with Jasmine 'ThatBronzeGirl' Bhullar, Dungeon Master of the official Dungeons & Dragons liveplay and Dimension 20's Coffin Run, talking about the art of storytelling, and fellow Dimension 20 alumnus Ify Nwadiwe taking part in a D&D one-shot with Deerstalker Pictures .

Other guests include composer Mick Gordon and fantasy author Isobelle Carmody. PAX Australia runs from October 9–11 at the Melbourne Convention and Exhibition Centre, and the full schedule is online at the PAX website now.

content.v: Level-5确认，《雷顿教授与蒸汽新世界》将于2026年12月10日发售，登陆Nintendo Switch 2、Nintendo Switch、PS5和PC。游戏还将提供包括简中在内的多语言本地化支持。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260910/1789006748_212663_jpg_r.jpg
本作最早于2023年2月公开，是《雷顿教授》系列的新作。故事发生在《雷顿教授与最后的时间旅行》结束一年后，卢克与雷顿教授将在美国城市蒸汽野牛城重逢，并携手调查一桩新的谜案。
蒸汽野牛城依靠蒸汽技术发展。玩家解开的谜题会直接影响城市面貌，随着 解谜 进度推进，城市也将逐步成长，探索过程与谜题挑战由此产生联系。
Level-5表示，本作拥有系列迄今数量最多的谜题，并邀请教育娱乐团体QuizKnock参与设计。游戏还将加入3D场景、世界地图、硬币雷达系统以及新的同行角色。
操作方面，除Nintendo Switch版外，其他版本将支持鼠标。主题曲则由作曲家久石让与歌手、词作者幾田莉拉合作完成。

视频欣赏：

items.title: 没吹得那么神!iPhone Duo上手折痕明显 乔布斯惊坐起
items.summary: 没吹得那么牛！iPhone Duo上手折痕明显 乔布斯惊坐起

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609100944451575.png
苹果首款折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo 于9月9日正式发布后，首批实机体验也迅速在社交平台流传。其中最受关注的依旧是折叠屏绕不开的“折痕”问题。从目前曝光的上手照片和视频来看，iPhone Duo的屏幕折痕并非完全不可见，在特定角度和光线下依然比较明显。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609100944524900.jpg
这一表现也迅速引发网友讨论。部分用户认为，苹果此前对iPhone Duo内屏的宣传明显更加积极，产品介绍中强调屏幕经过特殊设计，并通过相关工艺尽量降低折痕的视觉影响，因此不少人原本期待它能够达到接近“无痕”的效果。但从目前流出的实机画面来看，折痕依旧存在，甚至在正面观看时也能够辨认出来。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609100944535860.jpg
苹果官方则在产品页面中表示，iPhone Duo采用“非常平整光滑”的内屏，并加入特殊纳米纹理表层，以减少眩光和反光，让整体观看体验更加连贯。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609100945479684.png
和国外一样，国内科技博主也纷纷吐槽“有痕”：
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609100945498261.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609100946141288.png
值得注意的是，iPhone Duo采用7.6英寸内屏、5.4英寸外屏，起售价达到1999美元，中国大陆售价15999元起，并将于10月23日正式发售。

items.title: 《火影忍者》新剧场版来了！10月10日正式公布
items.summary: 近日，据《Variety》独家报道，经典IP《火影忍者》将推出全新动画剧场版，本作的官方情报将于2026年纽约动漫展（NYCC）的系列专题座…

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609100942332945.png
近日，据《Variety》独家报道，经典IP《火影忍者》将推出全新动画剧场版，本作的官方情报将于2026年纽约动漫展（NYCC）的系列专题座谈会上正式对外公开。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609100942398469.jpg
本次《火影忍者》专属专题活动定于2026年10月10日在纽约举办，该日期恰逢主角漩涡鸣人的生日，官方选址极具纪念意义。本次座谈会嘉宾阵容重磅十足，官方已确认漩涡鸣人日语声优竹内顺子、宇智波佐助日语声优杉山纪彰将作为特邀嘉宾出席，同时Studio Pierrot（小丑社）执行制作人、万代官方代表也将亲临现场，参与本次系列新作的情报发布环节。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609100942465064.png
根据《Variety》披露的座谈会官方议程，本次活动核心爆料内容包含多项重磅企划，除了全新《火影忍者》动画剧场版官宣、全球首映相关情报外，还将公开2027年上线的《火影忍者》官方集换式卡牌游戏（TCG）全新资讯与首支宣传PV，同时会陆续释出IP衍生多媒体项目的多款惊喜新企划。

content.v: 多人协作动作益智游戏《PICO PARK》系列与SEGA《刺猬索尼克》的联动游戏《索尼克PICO PARK》将于11月12日发售。游戏规则非常简单，只要所有玩家都成功到达画面右侧的终点即可通关。不过，想要抵达终点往往需要玩家之间紧密配合。互相协助、共同破解机关，才能顺利完成关卡挑战。
https://image.gcores.com/b12b00ec0ad2183753e5184292f3c621-1920-1080.jpg
https://image.gcores.com/e7a1b24a2b23ff92dceb67422a400684-1920-1080.jpg
https://image.gcores.com/4e5d44b63fa66bbd4cca8364ff8999cf-1920-1080.jpg
https://image.gcores.com/f660401c512d3129bf1b884b244e0320-1920-1080.jpg
本次联动作品中，所有角色都能够使用《索尼克》系列的“旋转冲刺”动作。“金环”、“环形地形”、“弹簧”等经典元素也将悉数登场，让玩家在《PICO PARK》的世界中体验原汁原味的《索尼克》风格关卡。
https://image.gcores.com/d5a0889b55679383151ac8054bb00e96-1920-1080.jpg
历代《PICO PARK》系列作品一样，本作支持2～8人本地及线上联机游玩，所有游戏内容均可根据不同人数进行体验。同时，线上模式还支持跨平台联机，让不同平台的玩家也能一同畅玩！此外，一台PC最多可支持7人参与线上联机游戏。

items.title: 微软XBOX全新发布会官宣！9月17日不见不散
items.summary: Xbox官方今日宣布，将参加今年9月17日开幕的东京电玩展（TGS2026）。官方表示，今年是Xbox品牌25周年，也是Xbox进入日本市场20周年…

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609100922025831.jpg
微软官方今日宣布，XBOX将参加今年9月17日开幕的东京电玩展（TGS2026）。官方表示，今年是Xbox品牌25周年，也是Xbox进入日本市场20周年，为此将带来专场发布会、现场试玩以及FanFest活动。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609100922082096.png
发布会定于9月17日晚7点（北京时间下午6点）在Xbox官方频道播出，届时将公开TGS独占内容与全新实机演示。展台方面，《我的世界：地下城2》将首次在TGS提供试玩，游戏将于9月29日发售，首发加入Game Pass。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609100922231924.png
此外，Xbox 还宣布本届 TGS 的吉祥物黑猫将正式亮相，玩家之后可通过官方社交渠道投票为它命名。Xbox FanFest日本站同样定于9月17日举行。发布会将在TGS官方频道及美日Xbox官方频道同步直播，支持手语及英语音频解说，后续还将追加包括简体中文在内的多语言字幕。

items.summary: 从2021年开启抢先体验至今，《英灵神殿》已经陪伴玩家走过五年多的时间。游戏上线后迅速席卷全球，Steam历史同时在线人数峰值突破 50万 ，累计销量早已突破 1000万份 ，成为近年来多人合作生存建造品类最具代表性的作

content.v: 从2021年开启抢先体验至今，《英灵神殿》已经陪伴玩家走过五年多的时间。游戏上线后迅速席卷全球，Steam历史同时在线人数峰值突破50万，累计销量早已突破1000万份，成为近年来多人合作生存建造品类最具代表性的作品之一。
https://image.gcores.com/3dddf47954e1d901e0d70ba6c97a721a-6000-3320.jpeg
如今，这场远征，终于迎来了完整的1.0版本。
老玩家免费更新，新玩家从此刻开启完整旅程
https://image.gcores.com/3dc4bce674b1e421cac2c3f7d7bc73d4-2219-1248.png
现有《英灵神殿》玩家将在1.0 上线后免费获得正式版更新。
对于老玩家来说，可以继续保留并使用此前的角色与世界；而Iron Gate也建议希望完整体验 1.0 内容的玩家，从新的世界重新开始一段冒险。
对于第一次进入《英灵神殿》的玩家而言，1.0则意味着现在终于可以从最初的青青草原一路走向世界最北端，体验完整的维京成长与远征旅程。
从一无所有开始，写下属于自己的维京传奇
https://image.gcores.com/db5bb314344e58a7d30d1f9b5bd13082-6001-3323.jpg
在《英灵神殿》中，玩家将扮演被奥丁送往第十世界的维京战士。
从最初的一无所有开始，玩家需要采集资源、制作装备、建立据点，并与伙伴一起跨越森林、群山、沼泽与海洋，在不断深入不同生态区域的过程中挑战更加强大的敌人与Boss。
有人选择在海边搭起一座小木屋，有人花费数百小时建成恢弘的维京城堡；有人驾船驶向地图尽头，也有人只是喜欢和朋友围坐在篝火旁，规划下一次远征。
建造、探索、航海、战斗与多人合作，共同构成了《英灵神殿》独特的冒险体验。
最后的未知之地——「极北深境」
https://image.gcores.com/9c1034e02d10dd29585895f51a9c6fbb-2219-1248.png
随着1.0正式上线，《英灵神殿》也将迎来此前规划中的最终生物群系「极北深境」。
在世界最北端，漫天风雪掩盖着新的危险。玩家将在这里面对全新的环境与挑战，并继续自己的最终远征。
「极北深境」也将补上《英灵神殿》完整世界进程中的最后一块拼图，让从最初踏入第十世界，到一路成长、远航并挑战最终未知之地的旅程真正形成完整闭环。
本次 1.0 正式版将带来《英灵神殿》迄今最重要的一次内容扩充。除了全新的最终生态区“极北深境”外，游戏还将新增 40 余种武器、4 套护甲、2 件披风、2 件饰品、30 余种制作材料、20 余种食物、10 余种全新生物，以及 80 余个可建造部件，同时加入新的地点、音乐、事件与玩法机制。
在探索与战斗层面，玩家将面对来自极北深境的新敌人与首领，并通过抓钩、全新武器体系、炸弹与弹药等新手段拓展战斗与移动方式；生存与建造部分则加入积雪环境、冰面探索、全新的建造组件、家具与生产设施，进一步丰富基地经营与世界探索体验。

items.title: 甲亢哥见苹果新CEO!手持iPhone Duo合影 现场翻跟头
items.summary: 甲亢哥见到苹果新CEO！手持iPhone Duo合影 现场翻跟头

content.v: 今日，苹果举行2026秋季新品发布会，这也是苹果新任CEO约翰·特努斯上任后首次主持秋季新品发布会。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609100821418743.png
发布会结束后，美国网红“甲亢哥”IShowSpeed在现场见到了特努斯，并拿着苹果刚刚发布的首款折叠屏手机iPhone Duo与其合影。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609100821481807.png
随后，甲亢哥更是直接拿着iPhone Duo在现场表演起了翻跟头，延续了其一贯极具个人特色的“整活”风格。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609100821496465.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609100821539712.png
作为苹果首款折叠屏产品，iPhone Duo采用横向内折形态，机身配备5.4英寸外屏，展开后内屏尺寸达到7.6英寸。
其内屏首次引入屏下摄像头方案，正面没有挖孔遮挡，进一步提升了大屏状态下的完整观感。
为了改善折叠屏常见的折痕问题，苹果还为iPhone Duo设计了全新的可变扭矩铰链结构，并加入磁吸辅助闭合方案，屏幕刚性较行业其他显示屏提升40%。
性能部分，iPhone Duo采用A20 Pro芯片，由台积电2nm工艺打造，同时配备12GB内存以及苹果新一代C2蜂窝调制解调器。
价格方面，iPhone Duo起售价为15999元，将于10月16日晚8点开启预购，10月23日正式发售。

items.title: Investor Accidentally Pitches Kickass Pokemon Apocalypse Movie
items.summary: For more than three decades, Pokemon and its various card and video games have enjoyed sustained popularity ar

content.v: For more than three decades, Pokemon and its various card and video games have enjoyed sustained popularity around the world. And at least one prominent collector and investor--Griffin Gaming Partners co-founder Peter Levin--believes that Pokemon's enduring appeal not only extends to the present, it could continue even if the world suddenly came to an end.

"Pokemon is a global phenomenon," Levin told The Hollywood Reporter . "I'm absolutely convinced that if the world suffered an apocalypse tomorrow, the following day the global currency would be Pokemon cards. Pokemon cards are beating the S&P 500 by 3,000%. Emanating from Japan, it really took hold around the world in the late '90s and early 2000s. It then had a zenith moment and then a nadir moment, and ever since then, it's been on a parabolic growth curve."

As unlikely as that scenario might seem, there could be a very entertaining movie based on survivors using Pokemon cards as currency during an apocalypse. It would be probably even better with actual Pokemon--like the Detective Pikachu movie--but Levin's really hit on fun idea even if it doesn't have a basis in reality.

Everything Levin said about Pokemon's popularity is correct. There's a reason why the Japanese mob reportedly used rare Pokemon cards to launder money or for increasingly brazen robberies of Pokemon cards from stores across the US. Some people are willing to pay ridiculous amounts of money for the rarest Pokemon cards and collectibles.

However, that value can only hold if the cards have some intrinsic value outside of Pokemon fans. They're only valuable as long as someone puts real currency toward them. Without that network of dedicated buyers, Pokemon cards wouldn't be worth the paper they're printed on when the world goes to hell.

Before any potential apocalypse comes along, Pokemon is getting a new stop-motion animated series on Disney+. The September 2026 events for Pokemon Go were also recently announced. Earlier this summer, Pokemon Pokopia received a DLC update as well.

content.v: 今年6月时，Remedy公布了《控制：共振》的初最低和推荐系统配置要求。而今天，距离游戏发售仅剩两周多一点的时间，这家芬兰工作室正式公布了完整PC配置要求，包括发烧友模式、光线追踪最低配置、光线追踪推荐配置和路径追踪发烧友模式等预设配置。

高端配置需要RTX 5080来进行路径追踪，而最低配置则需要GTX 1070

items.title: How to mine the petrified Gammeltroll in Valheim
items.summary: The Deep North's big brute doesn't fall down when he dies. Here's what to do about it.

content.v: Have you met Valheim 1.0's mountainous menace, the Gammeltroll? If you've made your way to Valheim's final biome, the Deep North, you've probably seen and fought it already: the Gammeltroll is a 30-foot tall rock monster who pelts you with tree trunks from range and stomps you into paste if you get too close.

Most interestingly, when you defeat the Gammeltroll, it doesn't fall down. Instead, it turns into a statue called a "Petrified Gammeltroll." You can chip away at its legs all you want, but even the toughest pickaxe in the game won't make a dent. And as you might have guessed, inside the Gammeltroll awaits a critical new resource you'll need to conquer the frozen biome. So, how do you mine it?
Valheim: How to mine the petrified Gammeltroll
The key to destroying the petrified Gammeltroll lies in the previous biome, the Ashlands, plus a new resource found in the Deep North.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/83U6hkNCBVxvKRv6SZV5A3.jpg
Build the Eternal Pyre
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/qFDqP2sgG252qL6xRSaDx7.jpg
Craft Ember Charges

Once you have ember charges, equip them and throw them at the petrified Gammeltroll. I find it best to throw them at its ankles from point blank range , then run away before they explode. With this method, it only takes two ember charges, one for each ankle, to destroy the statue.
(I wouldn't advise using ember charges as weapons against a living Gammeltroll. It'll damage the troll, but not enough to be worth it.)

When the troll collapses into a pile of rubble, collect your new resource, Petrified Tissue! Be warned, it's very heavy so you can't carry much, and it won't pass through wooden portals , only stone ones. Back at your base, throw it into your blast furnace and see what you get!

content.v: 关于AI是否会取代人类工作这一话题，一直存在大量争论。随着这项技术持续快速发展，越来越多人开始担忧AI可能会给未来带来的影响。近日，一名前Anthropic研究人员也站出来发出警告，称AI可能会对全人类构成威胁。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260910/1788994430_324747_jpg_r.jpg
Anthropic前研究人员Jacon Coxon表示，到本世纪末，AI系统可能会变得足够强大，甚至威胁到人类的生存。
这名研究人员过去也曾与OpenAI合作。他认为，两家公司都在朝着超级智能的方向快速推进。Coxon表示，那些从事AI研发的人其实非常清楚这项技术可能对整个人类构成的威胁。
他认为，AI很快就可能具备入侵任何系统的能力，甚至能够在极短时间内获得真正的权力。Coxon最终警告称，AI未来甚至可能导致人类灭绝。
“打造AI的人是真心相信，到本世纪末，AI可能会杀死我们所有人。”
有趣的是，Anthropic的对齐科学负责人Evan Hubinger也加入了这场讨论，并认同Jacon Coxon的观点。他表示，这种情况最终成真的可能性超过10%。
Hubinger认为，真正值得所有人担忧的是超级智能。未来AI自主学习和自我改进的能力可能会达到一个前所未有的程度，其表现将完全不同于人类过去见过的任何事物。
如今，也有越来越多人呼吁这些AI公司采取必要的安全措施，以防这些预测最终真的成为现实。

items.title: Valorant Cheater Using Evil Tung Tung Tung Sahur Skin Banned After Viral Video Sparks Backlash Against Riot's Anti-Cheat
items.summary: A hacker using an ‘Evil’ Tung Tung Tung Sahur skin has been banned after wreaking havoc in Valorant lobbies an

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/09/evil-tung-tung-sahur-hacker-valorant-1788993918253.jpg
A hacker using an ‘Evil’ Tung Tung Tung Sahur skin has been banned after wreaking havoc in Valorant lobbies and decimating entire teams.

Cheaters are a never-ending issue in online multiplayer games, but some are more memorable than others. A recent hacking incident has produced possibly one of the most memorable cheaters of all — or at least, one of the most visually disturbing.

As pointed out by Dexerto , a hacker using an ‘Evil’ Tung Tung Tung Sahur skin has sparked backlash within the Valorant community, and it’s not hard to see why. The skin, modeled after the viral brainrot meme Tung Tung Tung Sahur, has transformed the character into a deranged-looking, evil version of himself. (I choose to believe that Evil Tung Tung Tung Sahur is the ‘Evil Ryu’ to Tung Tung Tung Sahur’s normal form.)
Evil Tung activities | #VALORANT pic.twitter.com/wQaPMF7TxD

Footage of the hacker went viral on social media, showing the cheater in third-person from what appears to be their own perspective. We can see the outlines of enemies through walls as Evil Tung walks backwards, shooting his gun at nothing — only for his opponents to drop like flies in a blink.

This video showed that the cheater seemed to have enabled wallhacks and auto-targeting, but it’s uncertain if they were using any other methods to decimate these lobbies. It took the Valorant community by storm, prompting popular analyst ‘vladk0r’ to post it as a jab against Riot's kernel-level anti-cheat system, Vanguard.

“Imagine losing to a team with this s**t only for them being banned later after [a] few rounds of the bracket, and not being able to do anything with this, ‘cause they got DQ’d much later after your match, so Riot can't revert the results,” he wrote .

“Proof that kernel-level anti-cheat compromises user privacy and security for nothing,” another player argued . “Cheaters own and control the hardware the game runs on, they always find a way eventually. You don't need more privilege in a client-side AC, you need server-side AC and behavioural analysis.”
“Kernel-level anti-cheat really thought it could stop Tung Tung Tung Cheat-Hur,” another joked .

Thankfully, Valorant lobbies weren’t plagued for much longer; Riot’s anti-cheat director Phillip Koskinas responded to the issue in a tweet confirming that the cheater had been banned, along with their Riot ID, the name of their cheat (which Koskinas dubbed ‘lowskill vibeslop’), and how many games they’d played.

“We can detect anything with time, but VAL is a free to play game. Agree that we have to improve pre-emptive posture for open qualifiers,” he wrote, adding that it was “pointless” to hide the hacker’s Riot ID.

Riot ID: FaeL o Anacondo#br1 Banned: 2026-09-03 Games Played: 3 Cheat Name: "Sysinfo" (lowskill vibeslop) Hiding the Riot ID: Pointless We can detect anything with time, but VAL is a free to play game. Agree that we have to improve pre-emptive posture for open qualifiers. https://t.co/4h1GpajkuQ
This dastardly, if disturbingly creative, cheater finally got what was coming to them after ruining games for so many players. Evil Tung Tung Tung Sahur’s wrath has ended.

有报道称，育碧已着手重制多款经典《刺客信条》系列老游戏，最近的迹象表明，初代《刺客信条》很可能是下一个被重制的对象。

从官方《刺客信条》Steam商店页面来看，育碧已经悄悄地对游戏进行了好几个月的更新。

items.title: Steam now requires Australian users to have a credit card to purchase R18+ games, and no, a simple bank debit card won't work
items.summary: If you don't have a credit card, you don't play adult games.

content.v: Valve rolled out 18+ age verification for Australian Steam users yesterday, which was inevitable: both PlayStation and Xbox have already done so and it is, after all, illegal not to, with fines up to AU$50 million at stake. But unlike PlayStation and Xbox, which offer a small handful of ways to verify one's adulthood, Valve has only one: you must own a credit card.

And no, your debit card won't work, or at least, mine doesn't. You'll need an actual credit card: a card that uses money you don't have, versus a card that uses money you do. It makes a bit of sense, because Australians need to be 18 to qualify for a credit card, whereas teenagers can own a debit card.

But there are other complications: You may be an adult and not qualify for a credit card because you don't earn enough money. You may not meet a particular bank's credit assessment criteria, as per CommBank . You may have a poor credit history. Or, you may simply not want to have a credit card because the prospect of spending money not in your possession is odd to you. If you fall under any of these categories—and I do the latter—then sorry: Valve won't sell you R18+ videogames.
It's not even possible to view the store page for an R18+ game. When I click on Doom 2016, I receive this message:

"Valve is required by the Age-Restricted Material App Distribution Services Code to verify that you are 18 or older before accessing mature content. If you wish to do so, please add a valid Australian credit card to your account and afterwards update the Mature Content Preferences."

As people online have pointed out , it's still possible to buy Steam keys for R18+ games from third-party sellers like Fanatical and Green Man Gaming, and then redeem them on Steam. So it's not a bullet proof answer, but then, few age verification methods are completely desirable. Third-party verification providers like Persona, for example, have raised serious privacy and information security concerns .
I've reached out to Valve to ask whether it intends to implement other age verification methods for Australian users and if so, when.

items.title: Nintendo Direct September 2026 No-Shows: From The Duskbloods to Mario
items.summary: Today's September 2026 Nintendo Direct has come and gone, and so has any chance of seeing the next 3D Mario, T

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2024/03/10/mariodatythumb-1710077353881.png
Today's September 2026 Nintendo Direct has come and gone, and so has any chance of seeing the next 3D Mario, The Duskbloods, and more highly anticipated games that ended up being no-shows.

Nintendo covered a lot in this morning's 45-minute slot. Metroid Ravenous is bringing Samus back for another 2D adventure , Kirby and the World Beyond is going 3D in 2027 , and Mario Kart World is finally getting some much-needed love with a new update. Nintendo Switch 2 owners are eating well in more ways than one, but many fans say they were left starving for something a little more filling.

For instance, the company's hybrid sequel console is barreling through its second year without a proper 3D Mario to call its own. The Duskbloods, FromSoftware's vampire-themed Switch 2 exclusive multiplayer game, was nowhere to be seen despite still carrying a 2026 release window. Rumors suggesting new Super Smash Bros., Nintendogs, and Luigi's Mansion games were in the works really only helped build the mountain of no-shows overshadowing the show in fans' minds.

Despite yesterday's Zelda anniversary stream packing in some big announcements , Nintendo players largely seem to agree that, save for the Metroid and Kirby highlights, today's September Direct could have packed a bigger punch as the year winds down. It's a lot to go over, but we've gathered all of the biggest absent games from the September 2026 Direct, regardless of whether they've actually been announced or not.
The Duskbloods

Even after a year of updates, the Elden Ring and Dark Souls developer has never wavered when it comes to the release schedule for its new game. As details have snowballed into the public consciousness in recent months , it feels like the only thing fans don't know about the game is its actual release date.

Today's Direct seemed like a perfect opportunity to pin something down on the calendar, so when it came to a close with Kirby and not Zork , fans grew concerned. It doesn't help that a recent network test didn't exactly go off without a hitch .
So, has The Duskbloods been delayed? Well, no – or at least not yet – but if FromSoftware still wants to see it out before the year is up, it's running out of time to make a proper announcement.
WHERE IS DUSKBLOODS pic.twitter.com/isvoF0FsKb
Luigi's Mansion 4

What is Next Level Games up to? The Mario Strikers and Luigi's Mansion series developer was officially acquired by Nintendo in 2021, but aside from assisting with the development of 2025's Metroid Prime 4 , the studio's last headlining release was 2022's Mario Strikers: Battle League .

Couple that with the fact that it's been almost seven years since the team put out Luigi's Mansion 3 , and you've got a recipe for fans on social media to wonder what's going on. Nintendo hasn't officially announced a new entry in Mario's brother's ghost-hunting series, but considering the last mainline game's success , many are hoping we'll hear from Next Level with a Luigi's Mansion 4 sooner rather than later.
https://t.co/FncmMJVNdA pic.twitter.com/KwOhwlcBzT
Animal Crossing

Again, a new Animal Crossing game isn't something Nintendo has explicitly announced, but that hasn't stopped fans from clamoring for more. The last time Tom Nook came to take players' Bells in a more formal manner was with 2020's monumental original Switch game Animal Crossing: New Horizons .

A Switch 2 version also gave villagers new reasons to return to their island getaways in January of this year, and Nintendo historically favoring long breaks between mainline releases. Despite all of this, fans weren't happy to see that a new Animal Crossing game didn't make an appearance.
Me because they didn’t announce animal crossing pic.twitter.com/A9pX0y7DLc
So... no animal crossing mention in the nintendo direct?? pic.twitter.com/gWtneLgaOk
Mario Kart World DLC

I know what you're thinking: 'But Mario Kart World did show up in the Nintendo Direct' – and you're right. Today's shadow drop is one of the open-world kart racer's biggest yet, bringing reimagined SNES courses for players to race through, free of charge. It's a nice addition, but judging by reactions across social media and even in our very own comment sections, Nintendo could have done more.

"Anything to avoid giving us new costumes or original tracks, huh?" one IGN reader commented on our update reveal story. "Better than nothing, I suppose, but still – I'm curious what Nintendo's long-term plans for this game are."

There's nothing really stopping the company from holding off on outfits or character DLC for a while longer. After all, Mario Kart 8 went on to receive add-on content in the form of its Deluxe release's Booster Course Pass years after its original launch. When or if more is on the way is unclear, but it's probably best if fans don't write off Mario Kart World just yet.
omfg just give us new characters and actual new tracks already pic.twitter.com/JLQpDCv9XN
A New 3D Mario
While something like The Duskbloods felt like a shoo-in, a new mainline 3D Mario game was never quite as certain. That didn't make its absence sting any less, though.

Super Mario Odyssey 's launch trailed behind the original Switch's release by about eight months. Now, 15 months removed from the launch of the Switch 2, we're still without a new 3D romp for everyone's favorite Goomba-stomping plumber.
"10 years without a 3D Mario game is f**king pathetic I'm sorry," one popular X/Twitter post said . "But hey, at least we get our second 3D Kirby in five years!!!!!"

Yes, yes, the wonderful Donkey Kong Bananza has helped fill the nine-year void , but that's not changing the temperature for fans online who were hoping Nintendo's Yoshiaki Koizumi would have had more to share during the show.
this direct really felt like this pic.twitter.com/ctVOxfhqZA
Super Smash Bros.

Here's where fan expectations veered from hopes to dreams thanks to recent rumors and leaks that started when notable leaker Malo932 spilled a few beans earlier this week. Despite the lack of any official announcement from Nintendo or series mastermind Masahiro Sakurai, one of the big games many were expecting to see was Super Smash Bros.

Yes, it's been nearly nine years since Super Smash Bros. Ultimate came out. Yes, it's been almost exactly five years since Kingdom Hearts' Sora joined as the game's final DLC. Yes, Super Smash Bros. Ultimate still hasn't received a Switch 2 upgrade. All of these things are true, but that didn't get us any closer to seeing a brand-new entry – or even a port – during the September 2026 Direct.

Malo932 got fans' hopes up when they said a new, non-port Super Smash Bros. game was in development a few days ago. Alas, the legendary platformer fighter video game crossover series did not return today. Fans took the news about as well as you would expect.
So we ALL thought the same thing here right pic.twitter.com/MOQtJTJSaX
pic.twitter.com/Hxq4e9XUCx
don't forget to hug a Smash player today
Nintendogs

If you've not been keeping up with the latest rumors, you might be surprised to hear that some fans were expecting the beloved Nintendo DS franchise, Nintendogs, to make a comeback. What this could look like on, presumably, a Switch 2 console is anyone's guess, but the puppy sim has entertained the masses before, so it can surely do it again.

items.title: Ikea made a Skyrim mod starring Matt Berry as a sentient shelf named Kallax Storageborn
items.summary: The mod includes a new quest, companion, and items—and as marketing stunts go, it looks pretty good.

content.v: The brands are at it again but this time I'm inclined to let it slide, because it's so nonsensical (which is a nice way of saying dumb ) that I can't help but be charmed. Ikea, the Swedish furniture-and-stuff giant, has released a mod for Skyrim called Kallax Storageborn: A new companion who is also a shelf, who is also voiced by Matt Berry.

If you think that sounds weird, it gets weirder, because this mod doesn't just add a companion, it includes an entirely new questline built around the character. Becoming encumbered in the game, as will inevitably happen eventually, will give you the opportunity to visit an abandoned dwemer emporium, where you'll embark upon a quest to "unravel the origins of a mysterious master."

During this quest, you'll assemble Kallax Storageborn, a companion "with unfathomable storage capacity," who can be summoned with a newly-added Thu'um—Skyrim's famous voice of power—even when he's not your active companion. Your ultimate goal: Tidy up the clutter plaguing the realm of Nords and Dragonborn.
The mod also adds new loot including the Meatball Helmet, which sadly I don't have an image of, and the mighty Allenblade, which I do:
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/sEUnZ2VkJE2eqjSAeknso7.jpg
The Kallax, for the record, is an actual series of Ikea shelves , while Matt Berry once did a Movember voiceover for Hockey Night in Canada.
He's done a few other things you may have heard of , too.

The whole thing is obviously a marketing stunt, but it's worthy of a few minutes of my attention for two reasons. One, as I already said, it's dumb enough to be charming; and two, some real effort went into it.

The quest is an actual quest—we're not talking Witcher 3 levels of complexity here, but it's a real thing to do—and Matt Berry speaks more than you might expect. Why Ikea would invest this much effort into such a silly mod? This I cannot say, except—well, here I am, writing about Ikea in a positive light. Oh no, I've fallen into their trap!
Hey, at least I'm not crying over an old lamp.

If all this isn't enough to convince you to reinstall Skyrim again , you can get a look at the entire Kallax Storageborn experience from YouTuber ESO (via Kotaku ), who recently streamed a playthrough of the whole thing . And if it is, you can snag the Kallax Storageborn mod, free, from Bethesda's Creations page .

items.title: How to make money fast in Wardogs
items.summary: An early guide to farming cash in Wardogs.

content.v: Playing Wardogs is a bit like playing Battlefield, except you have to buy every gun, magazine, helmet, and kevlar vest yourself. It's a milsim FPS that runs on a personal wallet—doing useful things for the team makes you money used to unlock permanent upgrades and temporary gear.

Wardogs is designed in a way that lets you play any role you want and still be a profitable teammate. But especially early on, it can be tough to make enough cash to consistently fund unlocks, and the game doesn't spell out some of the most lucrative playstyles. Based on dozens of hours in closed beta tests, here are some early tips for making money fast in Wardogs.
Bulkhead has stated the economy of the beta will change for the early access release, so some of these figures might change at launch. I'll be sure to update figures once we know them.
Spot, spot, spot with binoculars

The safest, simplest, and surprisingly efficient way to make money in Wardogs from minute one is to buy a $75 pair of binoculars. Binoculars (and its fancier variants) allow you to spot enemy soldiers, vehicles, and structures, temporarily marking them on the map and in-world for teammates.

On top of just doing a nice thing for your team, each successful spot (holding left-click over a visible target) earns you a small cash prize immediately, and when a teammate kills that target, you get an assist worth hundreds . The nice part of this strategy early on is you don't have to stick your neck out and risk your loadout before you understand the game: just perch up on a hill with a few of the Hot Zone or enemy FOBs, lay down, and be your team's eyes and ears.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/SpbXfPEXcRYducAzjAYRfB.jpg
Build a FOB

Another extremely safe, profitable playstyle is to grab a hammer, buy a FOB module, and build a base for your team in a strategically useful location. The default FOB spot at the start of the match is the tower nearest to your spawn. Ask your heli pilot to load up with FOB supplies (or do this yourself), and head to a tower. Once you're there:
Every productive swing of a hammer earns cash ($15 in the beta), and completing a build can be worth more than getting a kill ($1,200 to $1,500).
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/us5fp2T3dBfxeTX3ReU4YB.jpg
Revive others quickly and often

My favorite non-lethal way to make money while staying in the action is revives and heals. Reviving teammates is worth $900 (in the beta), and you can do it without buying any additional equipment. The problem is that the default revive speed is annoyingly slow, which is where resuscitators come in. The one-use revive items are cheap to buy in introductory levels, so if you want to become a human ambulance, you could:

That's what I did during beta weekends until I reached Medic level 11 and unlocked the defibrillator. Defibs are a larger investment at $1,600 (and $150 batteries), but they're the quickest way to revive teammates and each battery is good for five revives.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/yqp88NUqe5deDgqy9E7ejB.jpg
Drive the spawn vehicle to the zone

This won't always be an option, as only one person can do the job at a time, but driving your team's spawn vehicle (the APC with a satellite dish on top) from HQ to the zone is a quick gig that pays royalties. You can drive the APC to a FOB, leave it there, and make money every time a teammate uses it.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/vboS28MxdydwjrwW4dH5CL.jpg
Be a taxi

The best way to get from spawn to the zone in Wardogs is the spawn APC. When that's not an option, everyone needs a taxi. The cheapest way to earn cash as a virtual uber is to practice flying a helicopter in the firing range, then ferry people back and forth to the zone. Not only do you get direct cash for dropping people off in the zone, but nice people will give you tips, and you'll also get assist cash if they go on to get kills.

You have to be in the mood to do this job well: Helicopters aren't cheap for a new player, and you have to be good enough at flying to not crash or get blasted out of the sky by an RPG. Plus, you're essentially ignoring the shooting part of this shooter, which won't appeal to everybody. The reward is a steady stream of money and happy teammates.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/kLMrBYZnUqkqAPP6MAdrkB.jpg
Be a cheapskate

Not much to this one: Buy the cheapest guns, fill them with the cheapest ammo, paper-thin armor, and go get a kill. It's not the most exciting playstyle, but it can be if you treat it like a free loadout in an extraction shooter. Get a kill, loot that enemy corpse, and steal all of their better gear. Saving money while making money.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/qjrAq9i8sDo8PNjNbCEc4B.jpg
Play the Hot Zone

If you hadn't already noticed, you passively earn money for simply standing in the Hot Zone—hundreds of dollars by the minute, actually. You don't even have to shoot anyone, but you will earn extra for killing and assisting in the Hot Zone. If you want to get in the action, there's no better place to be.

items.title: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy's Surprise Switch 2 Port Has Some Fans Hoping for a Sequel
items.summary: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy has re-emerged, five years after its release, with a new Switch 2 version...

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/09/guardiansthumb-1788968133052.png
Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy has re-emerged, five years after its release, with a new Switch 2 version... and some fans hope it could lead to a sequel.

During today's Nintendo Direct, fans were surprised to learn that Eidos Montreal's Guardians of the Galaxy game is coming back. It's getting a new "Encore Edition," exclusive to Nintendo Switch 2, which not only brings the game to a new platform, but also adds new content like special outfits for the cosmic heroes. This news came as a bit of a shock, since the game missed sales expectations despite having great reviews , so fans assumed that we'd never see this iteration of the Guardians ever again.

Now, this new release has some hoping that the Guardians may live on. Over on social media, excited fans are pleading to Marvel and Eidos Montreal to produce a sequel. Maybe a Switch 2 version could be used to test the waters, but it's hard to say. Either way, it's great to see such a beloved game finding its way back into the market, and hopefully, it can create some demand for another entry in the series.

"Don’t sleep on this game, Switch players. It’s fu**ing dope," said one fan . "Do yourself a favor and pick this up! It’s a GREAT game! I hate the fact that this gem got overlooked (and Midnight Suns as well btw)," noted another .
"Can we just get a sequel? The people have been asking for years," asked another fan . "Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy 2, please," another pleaded .

These are far from the only people asking for a sequel or begging new players to check it out; the comments under the announcement posts from Marvel Games and the game's official account are flooded with similar responses.

Guardians of the Galaxy has seemingly had legs over the years. A year after its release, the team behind the game announced it had reached 8 million players, partially thanks to the game's inclusion on services like Xbox Game Pass. It's unclear how many people have played it since then, but it's frequently deeply discounted, so the numbers have likely only grown a fair bit in the last four years. Eidos Montreal also stated that it had no regrets over the game , despite it not being a big seller.

Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy: Encore Edition will hit Nintendo Switch 2 on November 5. Whether it gets overshadowed by the remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remains to be seen, but hopefully it can find a new audience on the platform.

items.title: 《鬼武者：剑之道》将推出官方前传网络漫画，每周六都会更新新章节
items.titleEn: Onimusha: Way of the Sword Is Getting an Official Prequel Webtoon With New Chapters Every Saturday

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/25/onimusha-thumb-1787682661000.jpg
《鬼武者：剑道》上周发布，我们认为这是一部 10/10 的杰作。
如果您已经开始行动或者对故事的侧面感到好奇，那么值得查看官方配套网络漫画。该故事是《剑道》的直接前传，任何拥有网络漫画帐户的人都可以免费阅读。
整个《鬼武者》系列发生在日本封建时代的另一个版本中。在游戏的经典时间线上，《剑道》的时间线是在上一个主线版本《梦之黎明》之后二十多年，将玄马的世界带入了江户时代。
配套网络漫画的副标题是“宿命的竞争”，故事发生在《剑道》主要事件发生之前不久。故事讲述了宫本武藏的对手佐佐木严流，他在复仇驱动的追求中发现了鬼手套​​，以变得强大到足以打倒武藏。
前传由美国工作室 Laurel Pursuit 制作，该工作室之前发行过《地下城爬行者卡尔》图画小说以及《堕落的反抗》等原创网络漫画。 Ominusha 网络漫画特别收录了网络漫画创作者 jjolee、hilluhri 和 BAEKSSE 的作品。
第一章于上周六发布，迄今为止点击量刚刚超过 20,000 次。未来的章节将继续在周六推出，但目前还不清楚完整的前传网络漫画最终会持续多久。
以下是该漫画的完整描述，可以使用网络漫画帐户免费阅读：
When you live by the way of the sword, there’s only room for one at the top.

Sasaki Ganryu has one goal: to become the strongest swordsman in the world. When a duel with the wandering samurai Miyamoto Musashi ends in humiliating defeat, Ganryu is consumed by rage. What follows is a bloody quest to reclaim his honor that leads him down a path of madness and obsession.

On his journey, he receives a mysterious artifact known as “The Oni Gauntlet”, that gives him a power no mortal blade could ever match. Hunting down ever-stronger foes has set him on a collision course to face off again against the only man who has ever bested him in battle.
A prologue to the latest game in Capcom’s iconic samurai action series: Onimusha: Way of the Sword.

This isn’t the first time Onimusha has extended beyond the gaming realm. A film based on the action series was pitched all the way back in the early 2000s, but was eventually canceled. What did eventually come to fruition was an anime adaptation , released on Netflix in 2023.

Most fans don’t consider that story canon to the games. The webcomic, in contrast, flows pretty much seamlessly into Way of the Sword while staying faithful to events from previous games in the series.

items.title: How Many Guest Characters Is Too Many? Tokyo Revengers X City of the Wolves Collaboration Sparks Fighting Game Debate
items.summary: The fighting game community is in the middle of a fierce debate over the amount of guest characters coming to

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/09/city-of-the-wolves-tokyo-revengers-debate-1788984589751.jpg
The fighting game community is in the middle of a fierce debate over the amount of guest characters coming to Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves .

On September 9, SNK announced two more guest characters coming to City of the Wolves: Manjiro "Mikey" Sano and Ken "Draken" Ryuguji from Tokyo Revengers . These popular shonen anime protagonists mark the latest in a string of guest characters for the game, which include Chun-Li and Ken from Street Fighter, pro footballer Cristiano Ronaldo, music artist Salvatore Ganacci, and Kenshiro from Fist of the North Star.

That’s a lot of guest characters for a game that’s only a little more than a year old — and while Ken and Chun-Li make sense given Capcom and SNK’s wealth of crossovers over the years, five guest characters from totally unrelated franchises feels a bit excessive to some players (myself included).

There’s a trend sweeping through popular fighting games lately where non-fighting game characters are being included in major titles like Street Fighter 6 , Tekken 8, and of course, City of the Wolves. For example, Final Fantasy 7’s Tifa Lockhart is coming to Street Fighter 6 next year, while Baki’s Yujiro Hanma is set to make a splash in Tekken 8 in 2027.

While these one-off characters aren’t ruffling too many feathers within the fighting game community (Tekken is a franchise known for including one or two oddball guests), the sheer amount of guest characters in CotW is raising eyebrows — especially given the fact that they don’t come from other fighting games.
“Lmfaoo, adding anything bruh. Kenshiro was dope, but what the f**k is this,” one player wrote on X.
“Funniest fighting game roster of all time bro,” another said .

“Love these two, but how did they get in over Baki, or hell, even Tokita Ohma?” another asked , referencing popular martial arts anime Kengan Ashura (which, funnily enough, celebrated a collaboration with Street Fighter 6 not long ago).

It’s worth noting that fighting games in general are no stranger to guest characters from totally different worlds; the Mortal Kombat franchise is perhaps the best example of this, having added characters like Robocop, Omni-Man, Homelander, the Terminator, Alien's Xenomorph, and many other similar fighters to its rosters over the years. However, the argument can be made that these additions followed a general theme in keeping with the Mortal Kombat vibe and universe, whereas City of the Wolves’ guests are all over the place (in fact, it’s the first time a real-life athlete has been put in a mainline fighting game — and what is Ronaldo doing in South Town, anyway?).

Whatever the case may be, SNK clearly sees a path forward with these guest characters, and I’m honestly intrigued where they’ll take the franchise next. Either way, the sheer amount of characters they’re adding to CotW per season is laudable… though not everyone is hyped for each fighter they’re putting out. (Speaking of which, can we get some more ladies on the roster?)

items.title: Ace Combat 8 Dev Says Tasha Was the Game's 'Most Expensive' Character to Design
items.summary: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve Brand Director Kazutoki Kono says developers spent so long working on Tasha that

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/09/ace-combat-8-brand-director-reacts-tasha-popularity-1788982364088.jpg
Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve brand director Kazutoki Kono joked that developers spent so long working on Tasha that she ended up being the “most expensive character” in the entire game.

Kono visited China for the first time to answer questions in a group interview with the media following a hands-on demo for the game, where he opened up about how popular Tasha has become over the last few months.

The pink-haired pilot is a fan favorite, and the game hasn’t even come out yet; set to release on October 2, oodles of future players are already obsessed with Tasha Severskaya , a former “star pilot in Yuktobania's acrobatic team, Zvezda.” Tasha hopped aboard the Endurance to capture publicity footage, but the ensuing war kept her on the vessel, and now she’s part of the Joker Flight squad.

Speaking with the media, Kono admitted that he was surprised by how popular Tasha had become on social media, revealing that he’s personally on “Team Kate Evans ,” the Lieutenant Commander and leader of Queen Flight. He also revealed that Tasha took the longest to develop out of any other character in the game, since the team kept tweaking different aspects of her design to make sure they got her just right.

“Work on Tasha started relatively early, and she was originally designed by a different artist. She is also the character that took the longest to finalize. Her story and direction were already set, but we kept modifying various aspects afterward, making her the character we refined the longest during development. That's why inside the development team, we jokingly call her 'the most expensive character,'” he said, per Invenglobal .
As for why she’s so popular, Kono thinks it has to do with her fashion sense, saying her pink hair and outfits reflect trends that are currently popular among fans.

“I think elements like her personality, outfit, and especially her sense of fashion in wearing military attire so uniquely happened to fit current trends well, which contributed to all the attention she received,” he explained.

We got the chance to preview Ace Combat 8 this summer, with IGN’s Will Borger saying it was a "very grounded game" that left him “satisfied, but knowing [he] still had so much more to do.” He also got to speak with the devs about their ambitious plans for the game’s multiplayer , which will include 100-player lobbies, several different mission types, and a co-op warfare mode.
Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve releases on October 2, 2026 for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, and PC via Steam.

items.title: 'We are no longer using that one red pipe asset we weren't supposed to use': The Blood of Dawnwalker hotfix clears up one of the game's more charming mistakes
items.summary: Dead bodies won't be so talkative anymore either.

content.v: A new hotfix for The Blood of Dawnwalker rolled out today, and you'll be happy to know that this one improves the game's overall stability, fixes several progression blockers, fixes an issue with controllers that was causing frame rate drops, gets rid of the famous red pipe—more on that later—and keeps dead folks from talking so much.
That last point, about the stiffs who won't shut up, doesn't figure as one of the update's highlights, which developer Rebel Wolves breaks down thusly:

Still, it's interesting. Conversational corpses are almost always upsetting, and not just because the dead shouldn't speak, although that's certainly top of the list. But also, they never have anything good to say. If you find yourself conversing with the remains of the recently departed, you can be just about 100% sure that it's not going to be a happy conversation about how well everything is going. Quite the opposite, in fact.

There is one example of chatty corpses that weren't entirely bad, to go off on a bit of a tangent: Atomic Heart is full of them, a bizarre side effect of the game's alt-history Soviet technology, and most of the talking dead are reasonably cool about the situation. But that's also more of a 'fading echoes' thing, rather than a body that just will not die, and I imagine that would have a way of leading to more philosophical exchanges.
In any event, from the patch notes, for a more prosaic take on the topic:

And then, yes, there's the pipe: "We are no longer using that one red pipe asset we weren’t supposed to use." That's a reference to a discovery last week of a placeholder asset in the game, bright red and clearly marked "Do not use this asset!" which somebody nonetheless used.

Kind of a shame that it's gone, really: I like to think of rogue placeholders as a kind of digital monument that everyone hears about, visits, and then ever-after can tell people, yeah, I saw that thing. I was there. Alas, I have not yet played Blood of Dawnwalker and so I will not get to see it, except on Reddit, which doesn't really count.
The Blood of Dawnwalker hotfix 1.0.4 is live now on Steam—the full patch notes are below.

others.title: 《上古卷轴 5：天际》官方宜家模组采用 Matt Berry 作为 Kallax 储物伴侣

content.v: I am not enthusiastic about what feels like an inevitable future wherein games and gaming subscription services are inundated with advertisements . That said, I am excited to reinstall Skyrim so I can play an elaborate Ikea ad.

Newly released on Bethesda's Creations site, Kallax Storageborn is a remarkably in-depth Skyrim mod that features the titular Ikea item. But rather than simply adding the Kallax shelving unit as an item you can use to organize your in-game house, the mod turns it into a companion that follows you around, holding an unlimited number of items on your behalf. Oh, and the Kallax is voiced by Matt Berry.

You can get a taste of the mod in the video below, showing off Berry's performance and even a modified version of the opening "You're finally awake" sequence. There are new items to obtain, including the Allenblade, which looks like a giant allen wrench, and the Meatball Helmet.

With the mod installed, there's a new series of quests that kicks off to find the parts to assemble the Kallax, eventually all culminating in a boss fight. To trigger the quest, you'll have to become over-encumbered, which raises the need for a walking, talking shelving unit in the first place.

Aside from the audacity of this idea in the first place, and the inexplicable yet wonderful inclusion of Matt Berry, I'm personally tickled by this focus on the Kallax. As someone who owns four of them in various sizes to display all of my various Legos, foolishly purchased collector's editions, and duck-ified versions of Yakuza characters important business papers, the idea of one following me around in Skyrim is genuinely amusing.
The mod is available for both the PC and Xbox versions of the game, and it's out now for free.

items.title: Gears Of War: E-Day Has A Smash Mouth-Inspired Achievement, And That’s Fantastic
items.summary: Following the big Steam leak that revealed achievement lists and more for upcoming games, Microsoft has offici

content.v: Following the big Steam leak that revealed achievement lists and more for upcoming games, Microsoft has officially released the list of Achievements for Gears of War: E-Day, and there is a Shrek/Smash Mouth-inspired one among them.
Players can unlock an achievement called "HEY NOW, YOU'RE AN ALL STAR..." by accumulating 25,000 kills in the Versus multiplayer mode. This Achievement provides 25 Gamerscore.
For anyone just catching up, 2001's Shrek famously featured the Smash Mouth song, "All Star,"

The most difficult Achievement to unlock appears to be "Dead Serious," which requires players to 100% the campaign on the highest difficulty, Insane, reach 25,000 kills in Versus, achieve max player level, and max out four classes. Players who do that will be rewarded with 85 Gamerscore, which is the most for any single Achievement in the game.

It is a big year for both Xbox and Shrek, as both celebrate their 25th anniversaries this year. The original Shrek movie was re-released in theaters this past summer, and Shrek himself showed up in various video games . As for Xbox, the biggest news event for the 25th anniversary has been Microsoft's decision to lay off thousands of people, close development studios, and cancel games .

Gears of War: E-Day releases on October 6 for Xbox Series X|S and PC, with early access arriving October 1 for people who pay more. E-Day will also be available on Xbox Game Pass at launch. There was a lot of evidence that Microsoft canceled a PS5 edition at the last minute; Microsoft denies this, but no one believes them .

items.title: Call of Duty introduces a gun skin that you can only see on an Xbox console
items.summary: Behold the Xbox gun.

content.v: Call of Duty has joined Microsoft's bid to reinvigorate interest in Xbox consoles, today announcing a Modern Warfare 4 gun skin that you can only see if you're playing on an Xbox.
You read that right: The Inner Circuit blueprint is an M4 skin granted to those who pre-order Modern Warfare 4 on any platform, but the gun looks totally different on the Xbox version.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/WexBcNLkXj5zNjAXFwze2j.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/EKX2LXFrPqYbFaSRVSW36j.jpg

The Xbox 25th anniversary edition of the skin is designed after the green translucent plastic of the original Xbox console—it also features an Xbox logo and "Xbox 25" branding on the magazine. It looks, I must admit, pretty cool. Too bad these pictures are as close as I'll ever get to seeing it, as I don't own an Xbox.

Platform-specific incentives are nothing new for Call of Duty—for years, a Sony partnership meant PlayStation players got extra double XP, and Xbox used to get first dibs on map packs—but what's strange here is how this cosmetic isn't just exclusive to one platform, but only perceivable by it as well. If an Xbox player wants to show off their green M4 to a friend on PC, all they'll see is a boring-looking grey gun.

In a dedicated Xbox gun blog post , Activision clarified that in all ways other than appearance, the weapon blueprint is the same across platforms: "Both versions use the same attachments and perform identically in-game."

That's certainly one way to make pre-orders for a preferred platform more attractive, though this approach strikes me as more confusing than simply giving Xbox players a unique skin that everyone can see. At least that way I would actually know when the guy who killed me is trying to show off their fancy Xbox gun in a killcam. Instead, non-Xboxers who don't read Activision's blog or this website won't even know the difference. Strange!
And to think: This time last year, my PC was an Xbox .
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/6offQUY4CXebir2TC27dMd.jpg

items.title: iPhone Duo是否有折痕？苹果称非常平整光滑
items.summary: 苹果现已公布旗下首款折叠屏手机iPhone Duo的国行价格，售价15999元起。该机将于10月16日晚8点开启预购，并于10月23日正式发售。

content.v: 苹果现已公布旗下首款折叠屏手机iPhone Duo的国行价格，售价15999元起。该机将于10月16日晚8点开启预购，并于10月23日正式发售。
对于消费者十分关注的折痕问题，苹果表示，iPhone Duo的内屏拥有平整光滑的显示效果，并采用特制纳米纹理工艺，可减少眩光和反光，带来更加连贯、流畅的视觉体验。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609100257563798.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609100257577679.webp
在屏幕结构方面，苹果采用了光学透明粘胶，使显示屏内部各层在折叠过程中能够顺畅地相对滑动，从而尽可能降低屏幕所承受的应力，并减轻折痕问题。官方还表示，这种结构能够让屏幕各层在折叠时如同书页一般彼此滑动，以减少长期使用后出现变形的可能。
外观方面，iPhone Duo提供星白色和夜空色两种配色，机身采用5级钛金属打造。手机展开后，两侧机身会连接为一个连续的整体框架，两块屏幕保持统一的屏幕比例，展开与折叠之间的过渡也经过特别设计，力求带来更加流畅的使用体验。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609100258154967.png
苹果称，iPhone Duo完全展开后将成为史上最薄的iPhone，其内部结构经过重新设计，将各类组件集中布局于摄像头区域，从而进一步压缩机身厚度。
铰链部分则采用定制设计，由100多个微小精密组件组成，既能在手机完全展开时将屏幕保持平整，也能够控制整个折叠过程。机身内部采用多层复合结构，并配合黏弹性粘合材料，使屏幕各层在折叠过程中能够彼此滑动，从而降低长期使用造成的形变风险。
此外，屏幕底层加入钛金属板以提升耐用性，并采用碳纤维支撑板打造轻量且坚固的基础结构，为显示屏提供稳定支撑。

items.title: 苹果首款折叠屏、18 Pro等新品亮相！你对谁最感兴趣
items.summary: 在今晚举行的苹果秋季发布会上，苹果一口气带来了多款新品。其中，iPhone 18 Pro系列、首款折叠屏手机iPhone Duo、新一代Apple Watc…

content.v: 在今晚举行的苹果秋季发布会上，苹果一口气带来了多款新品。其中，iPhone 18 Pro系列、首款折叠屏手机iPhone Duo、新一代Apple Watch以及AirPods 5都成为本次发布会的重点。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609100243203795.png
iPhone 18 Pro系列
iPhone 18 Pro系列国行价格正式公布，其中iPhone 18 Pro 256GB售价9999元，iPhone 18 Pro Max 256GB售价10999元。
配置方面，两款新机均搭载A20 Pro芯片，采用2nm制程、6核CPU与7核GPU，并配备两个神经网络引擎，重点强化AI性能、续航以及专业影像能力。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609100243252835.png
iPhone Duo：苹果首款折叠屏登场
作为本次发布会最大的新品之一，苹果首款折叠屏手机iPhone Duo正式亮相，国行售价15999元起，最高2TB版本售价26499元。
手机搭载A20 Pro芯片，并配备大尺寸VC均热板，官方称持续性能相比iPhone 17 Pro提升35%。此外，全球版本均采用eSIM设计，搭载C2基带，续航方面一次充电最高可达24小时，外屏播放视频最长可达44小时，充电5分钟还能观看约5小时视频。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609100243333189.png
AirPods 5：降噪和音质升级
AirPods 5国行标准版售价999元，无线充电盒版本售价1149元。
新耳机采用无耳塞设计，在佩戴舒适度方面有所提升，同时重新设计声学架构，并加入新一代自适应均衡功能。主动降噪效果相比上一代最高提升至1.5倍。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609100243427978.png
Apple Watch：Ultra 4续航更强
苹果还公布了新一代Apple Watch，其中Apple Watch Series 12售价399美元起，Apple Watch Ultra 4售价799美元起。
Ultra 4配备更大容量电池，并进一步提升能效，官方称最长续航可达2天。在完整GPS和心率运动追踪模式下可使用约18小时，最长续航运动模式则可达到45小时。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609100243525722.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609100243553782.png
一场发布会带来了四款颇具代表性的新品：更强的iPhone 18 Pro、更大胆的折叠屏iPhone Duo、续航升级的Apple Watch，以及主打音质和降噪的AirPods 5。那么，你对本次发布会苹果哪款新品最感兴趣？

items.title: We’ve Never Seen Anything Like This In Call Of Duty Before
items.summary: Activision has revealed new information about one of the perks for preordering Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4,

content.v: Activision has revealed new information about one of the perks for preordering Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, and it's a bit unusual.

People who preorder the game on any platform get the Inner Circuit M4 weapon blueprint, but those who preorder on Xbox will get a translucent OG green version of the gun to celebrate Xbox's 25th anniversary this year. Like the OG translucent Xbox, the weapon blueprint allows players to see through it.

If you preorder MW4 on any other platform, you'll get the same gun, but without the Xbox flourishes. Not only that, but if you're playing on PlayStation or Switch 2, you won't even see the translucent Xbox design. Only people playing on Xbox will.
Both versions of the gun are functionally identical, however, featuring the same attachments and gameplay characteristics.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Screenshot-2026-09-09-at-2.18.07-PM.png
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Screenshot-2026-09-09-at-2.18.14-PM.png
Beyond this exclusive weapon variant, Microsoft is rewarding Xbox MW4 players by offering them a $5 credit to buy it on Xbox .

Microsoft owns Activision and the Call of Duty franchise, so this kind of exclusive offering makes sense. When Microsoft bought the franchise, it promised regulators that it would not water down Call of Duty games for platforms outside of Xbox , claiming 100% parity between platforms.
“We have no goal of somehow trying to use Call of Duty to get you to buy an Xbox console," former Xbox CEO Phil Spencer said in 2023 .
Modern Warfare 4 launches on October 23 for PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Switch 2, and PC.

content.v: 苹果现已公布旗下首款折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo 的国行价格信息，定价为 15999 元起。
具体规格：
该机提供星光白和夜空双色可选，提供 IP68 认证，屏幕方面采用四边一致的窄边框设计。手机内外屏拥有统一显示比例，手机内外屏均支持 Apple Pencil（今年晚些时候），其中内屏尺寸为 7.6 英寸（采用屏下摄像头），外屏 5.4 英寸，均引入纳米纹理材质，使用了 Apple 设计的抗划涂层，具有较高强度。

content.v: 苹果正式公布备受期待的首款折叠屏iPhone，命名为iPhone Duo。iPhone Duo 256GB版本售价1999美元（约合人民币13408元）。目前已开启预购，将于10月23日正式发售。
iPhone Duo配备一块7.6英寸Super Retina XDR内屏，以及5.4英寸外屏。其中，7.6英寸内屏面积相比iPhone 18 Pro Max大50%，相比iPhone 18 Pro大80%；5.4英寸外屏则拥有约相当于iPhone 18 Pro 90%的屏幕面积。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609100220313140.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609100220325446.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609100220322741.jpg
在交互方面，iPhone Duo将Touch ID整合至侧边按钮中，用于生物识别验证。
机身顶部和底部均配备扬声器，支持空间音频。手机提供“星白”和“夜空”两种配色，机身采用5级钛金属打造，并具备IP68级防尘防水能力。
性能方面，iPhone Duo搭载A20 Pro芯片，并配备全新的显示引擎，可以同时驱动内外两块屏幕。手机两侧分别配备独立电池，但两块电池会协同工作，并以一整块电池的形式提供全天候续航表现。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609100220452077.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609100220456015.jpg
在视频播放测试中，使用内屏时续航最长可达31小时，使用外屏时最长可达44小时。若同时以相近比例使用两块屏幕，官方称iPhone Duo可提供最长约24小时的续航。
iPhone Duo仅支持eSIM，并在全球范围内均采用这一方案。快充方面，手机充电约20分钟即可充至50%；充电5分钟后，使用外屏观看视频最长可获得约5小时的播放时间。
铰链部分能够在手机完全展开后将屏幕保持在平整状态，同时可以精确控制屏幕的展开与闭合。机身中框采用钛金属打造，并经过精密加工和抛光处理，呈现镜面般的光泽。苹果表示，iPhone Duo完全展开后将成为史上最薄的iPhone之一，这得益于全新的内部架构，关键组件被精密整合进摄像头区域。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609100221013285.png
在屏幕切换过程中，系统会让内容从外屏自然扩展至内屏，同时保持控件位于侧边的固定位置，并根据更大的屏幕空间自动调整内容比例。
iPhone Duo的中央结构平面加入支撑筋，以提升机身刚性；天线分割区域则通过高性能陶瓷嵌件进行强化。
机身底层采用钛金属板进一步提升耐用性，整部手机的铰链由超过100个精密组件构成。此外，屏幕下方还采用碳纤维支撑板，在保持轻量化的同时提供足够的结构强度，为显示屏提供稳定支撑。
苹果表示，相机系统是iPhone体验的重要组成部分，iPhone Duo搭载全新的Fusion主摄，可以记录更加丰富的细节。具体规格方面，手机后置配备4800万像素Fusion主摄，支持1200万像素级2倍光学变焦，并支持4K 120 FPS视频拍摄。
此外，手机还配备4800万像素Fusion超广角摄像头，以及1200万像素Center Stage前置摄像头。
